en: The Training Rule on Carrying a Weapon.
At that time, the Buddha, the Blessed One, was dwelling at Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove, Anāthapiṇḍika’s monastery.
Now at that time, the group-of-six monks were teaching the Dhamma to one who had a knife in his hand. ... [omitted] ...
"The training is to be observed: 'I shall not teach the Dhamma to one who is not ill and has a knife in his hand.
A weapon that is single-edged or double-edged.
The Dhamma must not be taught to one who is not ill and who has a weapon in hand.
Whoever, out of disrespect, teaches the Dhamma to one who is not ill and who has a weapon in hand, commits an offense of wrong-doing (dukkaṭa).
There is no offense if it was unintentional ... [and so forth] ... for one who is a beginner.
The ninth training rule is concluded.
